name: Evidence-derived text verification development checks
scope: Handwritten development checks derived from the fixed 30-document evidence snapshot, submitted as new text claims to the actual API. Expected labels describe support in this corpus, not independently adjudicated world truth. This is neither a held-out accuracy benchmark nor a social-feed coverage sample.
selection_notes: Assertions were selected after reading sources and before running these evaluations. Expected outcomes are not altered based on model results.
Most resolvable checks use RBI primary feed text; two use explicitly attributed claims from existing Hindi fact-check articles.
The Hindi corpus has ten Alt News articles but no fetched Hindi RBI or PIB documents. The Hindi RBI case tests retrieval of English evidence.
English/Hindi matched evidence-gap and amount cases are related controls, not independent samples.
Exact verdict counts and expected source URLs are checked mechanically. Valid claim splitting can require human review; matching counts and citations does not establish semantic correctness.
Artificial has_media input checks scope handling only; there are no images, videos, social media acquisition, paid judges, or real user posts in this suite.
